notes.title: UI Update
notes.content:
Changes:
*in game Ui updated! now much prettier 
*opening credits fixed
*Adjustments made to main menu (based on feed back) to make it easier to navigate
*now you can check out settings on main menu for UI explanations and action key list
*Crosshairs added upon popular request (I included an ammo count attached as well) crosshairs are toggleable for those who enjoyed the spray and pray game play
*Load screens between levels!
*Bug that hangs game up on reload of last level should now be fixed
*Many other small tweaks and fixes

Enjoy and thanks to everyone once again for the great feed back! keep it coming and I will do my best to continue tailoring Metal golem to the players.
I already have a couple more things planned, but if there is anything you'd love to see in the game please feel free to visit our Facebook page and or message me. I love to hear from you guys
once again thank you and have fun!
~Nikk

notes.title: Metal Golem 1.0!
notes.content:
I received many helpful ideas from our testers over the beta process to help polish up the game and get it ready for release.
Here are some of the additions made:

 Native Controller support
 Health pickups now respawn after 2.5 min (to help get that score even higher)
 Fuel system for jog has been implemented (watch for a green pickup at the original start location for additional fuel and ammo upgrades) every 60 sec.
 Minimum score of 50 points in order to qualify for leaderboard position
 Leader board now uses Steam name (with option to override)
 Game over menu spruced up
 A settings menu from the main screen (where you can toggle off the music and listen to your own mix)
 A Diagram explaining the controls of the game
 improved base movement speed
 Quick reload action

As a special thank you upon release All beta keys will transition to full build keys so you can continue to squash the Kaydiest swarms free of charge!

Thank you testers for your contributions to the game!
~Nikk McWhorter
